sahneler.metin: An earthquake struck off the coast of Peru.
Within minutes, a wall of ice and rock buried the town of Yungay.
The shaking broke the north wall of Mount Huascarán.
Ice, rock and snow fell down the valley.
It raced about eighteen kilometres at enormous speed.
It picked up mud and debris as it went.
It became the world's deadliest avalanche.
Yungay's site was declared a national cemetery.
